description: XcsB AlphaFold architecture and figure of BcsA landmark conservation in XcsA
code:
import requests, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent/1.0'})
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
def parse1(txt):
    ca={};b={};res={};allx=[]
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        an=l[12:16].strip(); rn=int(l[22:26]); rs=l[17:20].strip()
        xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])); allx.append(xyz)
        if an=='CA' and rs in t2o: ca[rn]=xyz; b[rn]=float(l[60:66]); res[rn]=t2o[rs]
    k=sorted(ca); return np.array(k), np.array([ca[i] for i in k]), np.array([b[i] for i in k]), "".join(res[i] for i in k), np.array(allx)

# ---------- XcsB (Q8DKF6) ----------
n,CA,B,seq,ALL = parse1(S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8DKF6-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text)
print("XcsB / Tvtlr0903 (Q8DKF6):", len(seq),"aa; mean pLDDT %.1f"%B.mean())
cen=ALL.mean(0); vt=np.linalg.svd(ALL-cen,full_matrices=False)[2]
print("  overall length on principal axis: %.0f A (MFP adaptors are elongated, ~100-120 A)"%np.ptp(((ALL-cen)@vt.T)[:,0]))
j=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8DKF6.json",timeout=40).json()
print("  UniProt features:", [(f['type'],f['location']['start']['value'],f['location']['end']['value'],f.get('description','')) for f in j.get('features',[])])
print("  N-terminal 40 aa:", seq[:40])
# alpha-hairpin detection: long stretch of residues whose CA-CA(i,i+100ish) distance... use radius of gyration per 20-residue window along axis
proj=((CA-cen)@vt.T)[:,0]
print("  pLDDT by block:", {f"{a}-{b_}": round(float(B[(n>=a)&(n<=b_)].mean()),1) for a,b_ in [(1,30),(31,70),(71,180),(181,300),(301,434)]})
# does it have a TM helix or lipobox?
print("  Cys in first 30 aa (lipobox candidate):", [i+1 for i,c in enumerate(seq[:30]) if c=='C'])

# ---------- Figure: XcsA conservation of BcsA landmarks ----------
lm=[("D179","D212",1,"catalytic Asp 1"),("D246","D260",1,"DxD"),("D248","D262",1,"DxD"),
    ("C318","C331",1,"FFCGS donor site"),("G334","G347",1,"pre-finger loop Gly"),("F335","Y348",0,"pre-finger loop tip"),
    ("T339","C352",0,"pre-TED"),("I340","V353",0,"gate/finger coupling"),("T341","V354",0,"TED Thr"),
    ("E342","E355",1,"TED Glu"),("D343","D356",1,"TED Asp, catalytic base"),
    ("Q379","Q392",1,"QxxRW Gln"),("R382","R395",1,"QxxRW Arg"),("W383","W396",1,"QxxRW Trp, channel entrance"),
    ("Q389","Q402",1,"IF2 Gln"),("P498","P512",1,"gating loop N-term"),("R499","F513",0,"gating loop pivot"),
    ("F503","G517",0,"FxVTxK Phe"),("V505","I519",0,"FxVTxK Val"),("E514","R529",0,"gating loop pivot"),
    ("R580","R601",1,"PilZ Arg, c-di-GMP")]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.2))
y=np.arange(len(lm))[::-1]
cols=["#2f855a" if c else "#c05621" for _,_,c,_ in lm]
ax.barh(y,[1]*len(lm),color=cols,height=.72)
for yy,(b_,x_,c,role) in zip(y,lm):
    ax.text(0.02,yy,f"{b_}  ->  {x_}",va='center',ha='left',fontsize=9,color='white',weight='bold')
    ax.text(1.03,yy,role,va='center',ha='left',fontsize=9,color='0.2')
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,2.6)
ax.set_title("BcsA landmark residues mapped onto XcsA (Tvtll0007, E5RST0)\n"
             "global alignment vs R. sphaeroides BcsA Q3J125: 31.3% identity, 49.9% similarity over 686 columns",fontsize=11)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color="#2f855a",label="identical in XcsA"),Patch(color="#c05621",label="substituted in XcsA")],
          loc="lower right",fontsize=9,frameon=False)
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
